body:
### Summary

uv 0.13.5 is published (GitHub release, PyPI and Docker images), but it was never added to the versions manifest in [astral-sh/versions](https://github.com/astral-sh/versions) (`v1/uv.ndjson`). That manifest's newest entry is still 0.13.4. As a result, `astral-sh/setup-uv` (v10.3.0) can't install 0.13.5:

```
Could not find artifact for version 0.13.5, arch x86_64, platform unknown-linux-gnu in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astral-sh/versions/main/v1/uv.ndjson .
```

### Platform

GitHub Actions `ubuntu-latest` runner (Linux x86_64). The manifest gap affects every platform, since 0.13.5 has no entries at all.

### Version

uv 0.13.5, installed through `astral-sh/setup-uv` v10.3.0. The failing step is in uv's own release workflow.

### Cause

In the [0.13.5 release run](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/actions/runs/39703477566), the [`publish-versions` job](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/actions/runs/39703477566/job/119588017202) failed at its "Update versions" step. The steps that update the manifest ("Commit versions", "Create Pull Request", "Merge Pull Request") were skipped:

```
error: No interpreter found for Python 3.14.9 in virtual environments, managed installations, or search path
hint: uv embeds available Python downloads and may require an update to install new versions. Consider retrying on a newer version of uv.
##[error]Process completed with exit code 2.
```

The step seems to request CPython 3.14.9, which this release adds (#22802), using a uv build that predates it. The `publish-docs / mkdocs` job in the same run also failed; I haven't checked whether it has the same cause.

### Impact

Anyone pinning `version: "0.13.5"` in `setup-uv` gets failing CI until the manifest is updated. For example, Renovate opens 0.13.5 update PRs because it finds the release through GitHub releases and the Docker image. Previous releases (0.13.2–0.13.4) were in the manifest within about a minute of release.

### Expected

0.13.5 is added to the manifest, for example by re-running the job with a uv that knows CPython 3.14.9.

Related: #22793 (the earlier, cancelled 0.13.5 release run).
title: 0.13.5 missing from the astral-sh/versions manifest: publish-versions failed ("No interpreter found for Python 3.14.9")
